interpretation: These are assertions of observed defects/control behavior, not desired-behavior tests. All outcomes are identical on the untouched original baseline and this pass. No production changes for these cases were included in pass 2.
next_pass_constraints: Persist every unacknowledged batch entry; newer queued entries for the same document must win.
Acknowledge exact per-key edit revisions; retain the existing persisted edits string-array compatibility.

Do not bypass first cloud reconciliation for whole settings/keybind documents.
Do not suppress union-before-upload reads when quiescing passive synchronization.
